messages:
Carlos: Kicking off staged rollout v2026-05-11 canary -> 5% ap-south-1 now per change window. Monitoring for 12m quiet.
Mei: Watching latency and embeddings error budget. Will call stop if p95 > 2.5x baseline or any 5xx spike.
ops-bot: ALERT: canary-ap-south p95 observed increase 95ms -> 410ms at T+5m. 5xx rate unchanged.
Taylor: Traces point to one host ap3-host-09 with repeated short-lived network stalls and elevated socket timeouts.
Carlos: Prefer a routing override to avoid losing canary telemetry. If override doesn't stabilize in 8m we prepare rollback to v2026-05-05. Agree?
Mei: Agreed. Route-override first, then rollback if we see persistent degradation. Also add a short-term cache-warmup hold to reduce upstream pressure.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: requested action route-override apply --selector canary:v2026-05-11 --exclude-hosts ap3-host-09 --until 6123460500 --reason "noisy-host-net"
deploy-bot: status: routing job rchg-11234 started
ops-bot: INFO: rchg-11234 progress: 2/3 updated, 1 retry pending
Taylor: One instance failed to update due to socket timeout; retrying now.
deploy-bot: status: rchg-11234 completed at 6123456842: 3/3 success
Mei: p95 back down to ~120ms after routing change. Cache warmup steady. No 5xx.
Carlos: Good. Extend observation window by 20m and annotate release notes: "Extended canary hold (20m) due to transient ap-south host networking issue; routing override applied; no rollback."
Taylor: Filing maintenance INC-7601 to drain and reprovision ap3-host-09.
Mei: I'll watch dashboards; if we see any recurrence within extended window we will either pin the canary to ap-southeast-1 or perform rollback.
Carlos: For now resume the slow ramp plan after extended quiet window. Closing thread unless regression observed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rchg-11234 completed successfully at 6123456842
ops-bot: NOTE: canary hold extended until 6123463500 per change update."
